fixture_prerequisites.shared: Start only after owned-run admission/resource permit. Keep the exact controlled fixture tab focused when clicking Run; capture the exact tab URL and served-byte SHA-256. Reset/reload fixture between cases. The current fixture route is test-only ephemeral; a native run must first register tests/browser/fixtures/form-controls.html as ownedPages['/form-controls'] in its owned fixture server and record actual loopback URL plus matching served-byte SHA-256. Until then cases requiring this page are not executable.
fixture_prerequisites.scroll: A separate controlled page with measured document height greater than the browser viewport is required; current form-controls fixture has no guaranteed scroll overflow. Add/register an owned scroll fixture with a stable element near the bottom before executing EXT-F-4057.
fixture_prerequisites.navigate: Requires an already registered owned fixture route and exact run-specific URL; navigate only between owned loopback pages, never an external site. The extension panel may need reopening after navigation.

procedures.name: navigate_active_tab
procedures.fixture: Owned loopback fixture route registered in the native runner; capture actual URL/hash first.
steps: Focus the owned fixture tab, open Tools > Catalog, choose All handlers, search navigate_active_tab and open it.
Positive JSON: {"url":"<exact recorded owned loopback URL>"}; replace placeholder with that exact URL before Run.
After navigation completes, reopen Tools if needed and inspect result.
Negative JSON: {"url":"not-a-url"}; Run to exercise schema rejection.
expected: Positive: result object has url equal to the owned URL, title equal to fixture title, status complete (handler waits for completion then reads tab).
Negative: UI shows Schema mismatch from z.string().url(); navigation is not issued.
No focused tab returns {ok:false,reason:'No active tab'}; do not treat this as permission denial.
procedures.cleanup: Leave tab on owned fixture or close that owned tab; never navigate externally.

procedures.name: click_element
procedures.fixture: Registered /form-controls fixture above; inspect #state output; reload fixture before each independent check.
steps: Focus fixture tab; Tools > Catalog > All handlers; search click_element and open it.
Positive JSON: {"selector":"#hover-target"}; Run once.
Negative JSON: {"selector":"#missing-target"}; Run once.
expected: Positive: {ok:true,tag:'button',text:'Hover target'} and fixture #state click counter for hover-target increases by one.
Negative: {ok:false,reason:'No element at index 0 for selector #missing-target'}; fixture state is unchanged.
Schema-negative {"nth":0} shows Schema mismatch: must provide either selector or ref.
procedures.cleanup: Reload owned fixture to reset counters.

procedures.name: type_into_element
procedures.fixture: Registered /form-controls fixture above; #keys begins as seed and #state reports its value and events.
steps: Focus fixture tab; Tools > Catalog > All handlers; search type_into_element and open it.
Positive JSON: {"selector":"#keys","text":"route-731","clear":true,"dispatch_events":true}; Run once.
Negative JSON: {"selector":"#hover-target","text":"route-731"}; Run once.
expected: Positive: {ok:true,tag:'input'}; #state keys becomes route-731 and #keys input/change counters each increase by one.
Negative: {ok:false,reason:'Element is not editable'}; no input/change events are added.
Schema-negative {"text":"route-731"} shows Schema mismatch: must provide either selector or ref.
procedures.cleanup: Reload owned fixture; clears edited value and event counters.

procedures.name: scroll_page
procedures.fixture: Dedicated owned scroll fixture with verified overflow and a stable bottom target is required; existing form-controls page is insufficiently tall by contract.
steps: Focus registered owned scroll fixture tab; verify document height exceeds viewport and record initial scrollY.
Open Tools > Catalog > All handlers; search scroll_page and open it.
Positive JSON: {"direction":"bottom"}; Run and inspect result plus page position.
Negative JSON: {"direction":"into-view","selector":"#missing-target"}; Run.
expected: Positive: {ok:true,scrollY:<number>} and window position is at document bottom (within browser scroll clamping).
Negative: {ok:false,reason:'No element for #missing-target'}; no successful target movement is claimed.
Schema permits direction alone; missing delta_y with direction by is handler-level {ok:false,reason:'delta_y required'}.
procedures.cleanup: Reload fixture or use {"direction":"top"} and confirm scrollY=0.

procedures.name: wait_for
procedures.fixture: Registered /form-controls fixture above. Choose the duplicate-name Action-tier raw row with schema selector/ready_state/timeout_ms; do not select canonical Read row with tab_id/condition/target.
steps: Focus fixture tab; Tools > Catalog > All handlers; set tier Action; search wait_for; open the row whose displayed schema has selector, ready_state, timeout_ms.
Positive JSON: {"selector":"#state","timeout_ms":1000}; Run.
Negative JSON: {"selector":"#missing-target","timeout_ms":300}; Run.
expected: Negative: {ok:false,reason:'selector #missing-target did not appear'} after bounded timeout.
Schema-negative {"selector":"#state","timeout_ms":0} shows Schema mismatch because timeout_ms must be positive.
procedures.cleanup: No page mutation; close expanded tool row or reload fixture. Do not record this as canonical agent-dispatch wait_for coverage.

procedures.name: sleep
procedures.fixture: No page fixture required; Tools UI remains sign-in gated and direct manual Run does not require active tab.
steps: Open Tools > Catalog > All handlers; search sleep and open it.
Positive JSON: {"ms":50,"reason":"bounded procedure"}; Run and record start/end from the UI observer without imposing a tight timing bound.
Negative JSON: {"ms":49}; Run.
expected: Positive: {ok:true,slept_ms:<number at least 50>,reason:'bounded procedure'}; elapsed time may exceed 50ms due to scheduling.
Negative: UI shows Schema mismatch because ms minimum is 50; handler does not sleep.
No fixture state or external page effect is expected.
procedures.cleanup: None beyond closing the expanded row.
